103                return (stability - 5f) * 0.05f;
104        }
105        public static float getNumShipsMultForStability(float stability) {
106                return 1f + (stability - 5f) * 0.05f;

110        public static float getNumShipsMultForMarketSize(float marketSize) {
111                if (marketSize < 3) marketSize = 3;
112                
113//              switch ((int)marketSize) {
114//              case 3: return 0.5f;
115//              case 4: return 0.7f;
116//              case 5: return 0.85f;
117//              case 6: return 1f;
118//              case 7: return 1.15f;
119//              case 8: return 1.3f;
120//              case 9: return 1.5f;
121//              case 10: return 2f;
122//              }
123//              switch ((int)marketSize) {
124//              case 3: return 1f;
125//              case 4: return 1.25f;
126//              case 5: return 1.5f;
127//              case 6: return 1.75f;
128//              case 7: return 2.0f;
129//              case 8: return 2.25f;
130//              case 9: return 2.5f;
131//              case 10: return 3f;
132//              }
133                switch ((int)marketSize) {
134                case 3: return 0.5f;
135                case 4: return 0.75f;
136                case 5: return 1f;
137                case 6: return 1.25f;
138                case 7: return 1.5f;
139                case 8: return 1.75f;
140                case 9: return 2f;
141                case 10: return 2.5f;
142                }               
143                
144                return marketSize / 6f; 
145        }
146        public static float getDoctrineNumShipsMult(int doctrineNumShips) {
147                float max = Global.getSettings().getFloat("maxDoctrineNumShipsMult");
148                
149                return 1f + (float) (doctrineNumShips - 1f) * (max - 1f) / 4f;

152        public static CampaignFleetAPI createFleet(FleetParamsV3 params) {
153                
154                CreateFleetPlugin plugin = Global.getSector().getGenericPlugins().pickPlugin(CreateFleetPlugin.class, params);
155                if (plugin != null) {
156                        return plugin.createFleet(params);
157                }
158                
159                Global.getSettings().profilerBegin("FleetFactoryV3.createFleet()");
160                try {
161                        
162                boolean fakeMarket = false;
163                MarketAPI market = pickMarket(params);
164                if (market == null) {
165                        market = Global.getFactory().createMarket("fake", "fake", 5);
166                        market.getStability().modifyFlat("fake", 10000);
167                        market.setFactionId(params.factionId);
168                        SectorEntityToken token = Global.getSector().getHyperspace().createToken(0, 0);
169                        market.setPrimaryEntity(token);
170                        
171                        market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.FLEET_QUALITY_MOD).modifyFlat("fake", BASE_QUALITY_WHEN_NO_MARKET);
172                        
173                        market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.COMBAT_FLEET_SIZE_MULT).modifyFlat("fake", 1f);
174                        
175                        if (params.factionOverride != null) {
176                                market.setCachedFaction(params.factionOverride);
177                        }
178//                      CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(Commodities.SHIPS);
179//                      com.setMaxSupply(6);
180//                      com.setMaxDemand(6);
181//                      com.getAvailableStat().setBaseValue(6);
182//                      com.setSupplier(new SupplierData(6, com, false));
183                        fakeMarket = true;
184                }
185                boolean sourceWasNull = params.source == null;
186                params.source = market;
187                if (sourceWasNull && params.qualityOverride == null) { // we picked a nearby market based on location
188                        params.updateQualityAndProducerFromSourceMarket();
189                }
190                
191                //params.timestamp = Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp() - (long)(3600 * 24 * 1000);
192//              params.timestamp = Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp();
193//              if (params.forceNoTimestamp != null && params.forceNoTimestamp) {
194//                      params.timestamp = null;
195//              }
196                
197//              if (market.getName().equals("Jangala")) {
198//                      System.out.println("wfwdfwef");
199//              }
200                
201//              ShipPickMode mode = ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_OTHER;
202//              if (params.producer != null && params.producer.getFaction() != market.getFaction()) {
203//                      mode = ShipPickMode.IMPORTED;
204//              }
205//              if (params.modeOverride != null) mode = params.modeOverride;
206                
207                String factionId = params.factionId;
208                if (factionId == null) factionId = params.source.getFactionId();
209                
210                ShipPickMode mode = Misc.getShipPickMode(market, factionId);
211                if (params.modeOverride != null) mode = params.modeOverride;
212                
213                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = null;
214                
215                if (params.factionOverride != null) {
216                        fleet = Global.getFactory().createEmptyFleet(params.factionOverride, true);
217                        fleet.setName(params.factionOverride.getFleetTypeName(params.fleetType));
218                } else {
219                        fleet = createEmptyFleet(factionId, params.fleetType, market);
220                }
221                fleet.getFleetData().setOnlySyncMemberLists(true);
222                
223                Misc.getSalvageSeed(fleet); // will set it
224                
225//              if (true) {
226//                      fleet.getFleetData().setOnlySyncMemberLists(false);
227//                      fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember("atlas_Standard");
228//                      return fleet;
229//              }
230                
231                FactionDoctrineAPI doctrine = fleet.getFaction().getDoctrine();
232                if (params.doctrineOverride != null) {
233                        doctrine = params.doctrineOverride;
234                }
235                
236                float numShipsMult = 1f;
237                if (params.ignoreMarketFleetSizeMult == null || !params.ignoreMarketFleetSizeMult) {
238                        numShipsMult = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.COMBAT_FLEET_SIZE_MULT).computeEffective(0f);
239                }
240                
241                float quality = params.quality + params.qualityMod;
242//              if (mode == ShipPickMode.IMPORTED) { // factored in by FleetParamsV3 calculation of quality
243//                      quality -= IMPORTED_QUALITY_PENALTY;
244//              }
245                if (params.qualityOverride != null) {
246                        quality = params.qualityOverride;
247                }
248                
249                Random random = new Random();
250                if (params.random != null) random = params.random;
251                
252                //Misc.setSpawnFPMult(fleet, numShipsMult);
253                
254                float combatPts = params.combatPts * numShipsMult;
255                
256                if (params.onlyApplyFleetSizeToCombatShips != null && params.onlyApplyFleetSizeToCombatShips) {
257                        numShipsMult = 1f;
258                }
259                
260                float freighterPts = params.freighterPts * numShipsMult;
261                float tankerPts = params.tankerPts * numShipsMult;
262                float transportPts = params.transportPts * numShipsMult;
263                float linerPts = params.linerPts * numShipsMult;
264                float utilityPts = params.utilityPts * numShipsMult;
265
266                
267                
268                if (combatPts < 10 && combatPts > 0) {
269                        combatPts = Math.max(combatPts, 5 + random.nextInt(6));
270                }
271                
272                float dW = (float) doctrine.getWarships() + random.nextInt(3) - 2;
273                float dC = (float) doctrine.getCarriers() + random.nextInt(3) - 2;
274                float dP = (float) doctrine.getPhaseShips() + random.nextInt(3) - 2;
275                
276                boolean strict = doctrine.isStrictComposition();
277                if (strict) {
278                        dW = (float) doctrine.getWarships() - 1;
279                        dC = (float) doctrine.getCarriers() - 1;
280                        dP = (float) doctrine.getPhaseShips() -1;
281                }
282                
283                if (!strict) {
284                        float r1 = random.nextFloat();
285                        float r2 = random.nextFloat();
286                        float min = Math.min(r1, r2);
287                        float max = Math.max(r1, r2);
288                        
289                        float mag = 1f;
290                        float v1 = min;
291                        float v2 = max - min;
292                        float v3 = 1f - max;
293                        
294                        v1 *= mag;
295                        v2 *= mag;
296                        v3 *= mag;
297                        
298                        v1 -= mag/3f;
299                        v2 -= mag/3f;
300                        v3 -= mag/3f;
301                        
302                        //System.out.println(v1 + "," + v2 + "," + v3);
303                        dW += v1;
304                        dC += v2;
305                        dP += v3;
306                }
307                
308                if (doctrine.getWarships() <= 0) dW = 0;
309                if (doctrine.getCarriers() <= 0) dC = 0;
310                if (doctrine.getPhaseShips() <= 0) dP = 0;
311                
312                
313//              float dW = (float) doctrine.getWarships() + random.nextInt(2) - 1;
314//              float dC = (float) doctrine.getCarriers() + random.nextInt(2) - 1;
315//              float dP = (float) doctrine.getPhaseShips() + random.nextInt(2) - 1;
316                
317                boolean banPhaseShipsEtc = !fleet.getFaction().isPlayerFaction() && 
318                                                                        combatPts < FLEET_POINTS_THRESHOLD_FOR_ANNOYING_SHIPS;
319                if (params.forceAllowPhaseShipsEtc != null && params.forceAllowPhaseShipsEtc) {
320                        banPhaseShipsEtc = !params.forceAllowPhaseShipsEtc;
321                }
322                
323                params.mode = mode;
324                params.banPhaseShipsEtc = banPhaseShipsEtc;
325
326                // with the phase AI changes: allow phase ships in smaller fleets
327                // but still ban the "etc" (i.e. hyperion, ships with damper field, etc - 
328                // anything not in the "combatSmallForSmallFleet" role
329//              if (banPhaseShipsEtc) {
330//                      dP = 0;
331//              };
332                
333                if (dW < 0) dW = 0;
334                if (dC < 0) dC = 0;
335                if (dP < 0) dP = 0;
336                
337                float extra = 7 - (dC + dP + dW);
338                if (extra < 0) extra = 0f;
339                if (doctrine.getWarships() > doctrine.getCarriers() && doctrine.getWarships() > doctrine.getPhaseShips()) {
340                        dW += extra;
341                } else if (doctrine.getCarriers() > doctrine.getWarships() && doctrine.getCarriers() > doctrine.getPhaseShips()) {
342                        dC += extra;
343                } else if (doctrine.getPhaseShips() > doctrine.getWarships() && doctrine.getPhaseShips() > doctrine.getCarriers()) {
344                        dP += extra;
345                }
346                
347                
348                float doctrineTotal = dW + dC + dP;
349                
350                //System.out.println("DW: " + dW + ", DC: " + dC + " DP: " + dP);
351                
352                combatPts = (int) combatPts;
353                int warships = (int) (combatPts * dW / doctrineTotal);
354                int carriers = (int) (combatPts * dC / doctrineTotal);
355                int phase = (int) (combatPts * dP / doctrineTotal);
356                
357                warships += (combatPts - warships - carriers - phase);
358                
359                if (params.addShips != null) {
360                        for (String variantId : params.addShips) {
361                                ShipRolePick pick = new ShipRolePick(variantId);
362                                warships -= addToFleet(pick, fleet, random);
363                        }
364                        if (warships < 0) warships = 0;
365                }
366                
367                
368                if (params.treatCombatFreighterSettingAsFraction != null && params.treatCombatFreighterSettingAsFraction) {
369                        float combatFreighters = (int) Math.min(freighterPts * 1.5f, warships * 1.5f) * doctrine.getCombatFreighterProbability();
370                        float added = addCombatFreighterFleetPoints(fleet, random, combatFreighters, params);
371                        freighterPts -= added * 0.5f;
372                        warships -= added * 0.5f;
373                } else if (freighterPts > 0 && random.nextFloat() < doctrine.getCombatFreighterProbability()) {
374                        float combatFreighters = (int) Math.min(freighterPts * 1.5f, warships * 1.5f);
375                        float added = addCombatFreighterFleetPoints(fleet, random, combatFreighters, params);
376                        freighterPts -= added * 0.5f;
377                        warships -= added * 0.5f;
378                }
379                
380                addCombatFleetPoints(fleet, random, warships, carriers, phase, params);
381                
382                
383                addFreighterFleetPoints(fleet, random, freighterPts, params);
384                addTankerFleetPoints(fleet, random, tankerPts, params);
385                addTransportFleetPoints(fleet, random, transportPts, params);
386                addLinerFleetPoints(fleet, random, linerPts, params);
387                addUtilityFleetPoints(fleet, random, utilityPts, params);
388                
389                
390                //System.out.println("FLEET POINTS: " + getFP(fleet));
391                int maxShips = Global.getSettings().getInt("maxShipsInAIFleet");
392                if (params.maxNumShips != null) {
393                        maxShips = params.maxNumShips;
394                }
395                if (fleet.getFleetData().getNumMembers() > maxShips) {
396                        if (params.doNotPrune == null || !params.doNotPrune) {
397                                float targetFP = getFP(fleet);
398                                if (params.doNotAddShipsBeforePruning == null || !params.doNotAddShipsBeforePruning) {
399                                        sizeOverride = 5;
400                                        addCombatFleetPoints(fleet, random, warships, carriers, phase, params);
401                                        addFreighterFleetPoints(fleet, random, freighterPts, params);
402                                        addTankerFleetPoints(fleet, random, tankerPts, params);
403                                        addTransportFleetPoints(fleet, random, transportPts, params);
404                                        addLinerFleetPoints(fleet, random, linerPts, params);
405                                        addUtilityFleetPoints(fleet, random, utilityPts, params);
406                                        sizeOverride = 0;
407                                }
408                        
409                                int size = doctrine.getShipSize();
410                                pruneFleet(maxShips, size, fleet, targetFP, random);
411                                
412                                float currFP = getFP(fleet);
413                                //currFP = getFP(fleet);
414//                              if (currFP < targetFP) {
415//                                      extraOfficers = (int) Math.round ((targetFP / Math.max(10f, currFP) - 1f) * 10f);
416//                                      if (extraOfficers > 30) extraOfficers = 30;
417//                                      if (extraOfficers < 0) extraOfficers = 0;
418//                              }
419                        }
420                        
421                        fleet.getFleetData().sort();
422                        
423                        //System.out.println("FLEET POINTS: " + getFP(fleet));
424                        
425                        
426                } else {
427                        fleet.getFleetData().sort();
428                }
429                
430                fleet.getFleetData().sort();
431                
432                if (params.withOfficers) {
433                        addCommanderAndOfficers(fleet, params, random);
434                }
435                
436                if (fleet.getFlagship() != null) {
437                        if (params.flagshipVariantId != null) {
438                                fleet.getFlagship().setVariant(Global.getSettings().getVariant(params.flagshipVariantId), false, true);
439                        } else if (params.flagshipVariant != null) {
440                                fleet.getFlagship().setVariant(params.flagshipVariant, false, true);
441                        }
442                        if (fleet.getFlagship() != null && fleet.getFlagship().getStatus() != null) {
443                                fleet.getFlagship().getStatus().updateNumStatusesFromMember();
444                        }
445                }
446                
447                if (params.onlyRetainFlagship != null && params.onlyRetainFlagship) {
448                        for (FleetMemberAPI curr : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
449                                if (curr.isFlagship()) continue;
450                                fleet.getFleetData().removeFleetMember(curr);
451                        }
452                }
453                //fleet.getFlagship()
454                fleet.forceSync();
455                
456                //FleetFactoryV2.doctrine = null;
457                
458                if (fleet.getFleetData().getNumMembers() <= 0 || 
459                                fleet.getFleetData().getNumMembers() == fleet.getNumFighters()) {
460//                      if (params.allowEmptyFleet == null || !params.allowEmptyFleet){ 
461//                              return null;
462//                      }
463                }
464                
465                if (fakeMarket) {
466                        params.source = null;
467                }
468                
469                DefaultFleetInflaterParams p = new DefaultFleetInflaterParams();
470                p.quality = quality;
471                if (params.averageSMods != null) {
472                        p.averageSMods = params.averageSMods;
473                }
474                p.persistent = true;
475                p.seed = random.nextLong();
476                p.mode = mode;
477                p.timestamp = params.timestamp;
478                p.allWeapons = params.allWeapons;
479                if (params.doctrineOverride != null) {
480                        p.rProb = params.doctrineOverride.getAutofitRandomizeProbability();
481                }
482                if (params.factionId != null) {
483                        p.factionId = params.factionId;
484                }
485                
486                FleetInflater inflater = Misc.getInflater(fleet, p);
487                fleet.setInflater(inflater);
488                
489                fleet.getFleetData().setOnlySyncMemberLists(false);
490                fleet.getFleetData().sort();
491                
492                List<FleetMemberAPI> members = fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();
493                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
494                        member.getRepairTracker().setCR(member.getRepairTracker().getMaxCR());
495                }
496                
497                float requestedPoints = params.getTotalPts();
498                float actualPoints = fleet.getFleetPoints();
499                
500                Misc.setSpawnFPMult(fleet, actualPoints / Math.max(1f, requestedPoints));
501                
502                
503                return fleet;
504                
505                } finally {
506                        Global.getSettings().profilerEnd();
507                }
508        }

510        public static void pruneFleet(int maxShips, int doctrineSize, CampaignFleetAPI fleet, float targetFP, Random random) {
511                //int maxShips = Global.getSettings().getInt("maxShipsInAIFleet");
512                
513                float combatFP = 0;
514                float civFP = 0;
515                
516                List<FleetMemberAPI> copy = fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();
517                List<FleetMemberAPI> combat = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
518                //List<FleetMemberAPI> civ = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
519                List<FleetMemberAPI> tanker = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
520                List<FleetMemberAPI> freighter = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
521                List<FleetMemberAPI> liner = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
522                List<FleetMemberAPI> other = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
523                
524                for (FleetMemberAPI member : copy) {
525                        if (member.isCivilian()) {
526                                civFP += member.getFleetPointCost();
527                                //civ.add(member);
528                                
529                                if (member.getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.FREIGHTER)) {
530                                        freighter.add(member);
531                                } else if (member.getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.TANKER)) {
532                                        tanker.add(member);
533                                } else if (member.getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.TRANSPORT) ||
534                                                member.getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.LINER)) {
535                                        liner.add(member);
536                                } else {
537                                        other.add(member);
538                                }
539                                
540                        } else {
541                                combatFP += member.getFleetPointCost();
542                                combat.add(member);
543                        }
544                }
545                if (civFP < 1) civFP = 1;
546                if (combatFP < 1) combatFP = 1;
547                
548                int keepCombat = (int) ((float)maxShips * combatFP / (civFP + combatFP));
549                int keepCiv = maxShips - keepCombat;
550                if (civFP > 10 && keepCiv < 2) {
551                        keepCiv = 2;
552                        if (!freighter.isEmpty()) keepCiv++;
553                        if (!tanker.isEmpty()) keepCiv++;
554                        if (!liner.isEmpty()) keepCiv++;
555                        if (!other.isEmpty()) keepCiv++;
556                        
557                        keepCiv = maxShips - keepCiv;
558                }
559                
560                
561                float f = 0, t = 0, l = 0, o = 0;
562                float total = freighter.size() + tanker.size() + liner.size() + other.size();
563                if (total < 1) total = 1;
564                
565                f = (float) freighter.size() / total;
566                t = (float) tanker.size() / total;
567                l = (float) liner.size() / total;
568                o = (float) other.size() / total;
569                
570                f *= keepCiv;
571                t *= keepCiv;
572                l *= keepCiv;
573                o *= keepCiv;
574                
575                if (f > 0) f = Math.round(f);
576                if (t > 0) t = Math.round(t);
577                if (l > 0) l = Math.round(l);
578                if (o > 0) o = Math.round(o);
579                
580                if (freighter.size() > 0 && f < 1) f = 1;
581                if (tanker.size() > 0 && t < 1) t = 1;
582                if (liner.size() > 0 && l < 1) l = 1;
583                if (other.size() > 0 && o < 1) o = 1;
584                
585                int extra = (int) ((f + t + l + o) - keepCiv);
586                //if (extra < 0) keepCombat += Math.abs(extra);
587                if (extra > 0 && o >= 2) {
588                        extra--;
589                        o--;
590                }
591                if (extra > 0 && l >= 2) {
592                        extra--;
593                        l--;
594                }
595                if (extra > 0 && t >= 2) {
596                        extra--;
597                        t--;
598                }
599                if (extra > 0 && f >= 2) {
600                        extra--;
601                        f--;
602                }
603                
604                
605                LinkedHashSet<FleetMemberAPI> keep = new LinkedHashSet<FleetMemberAPI>();
606                
607                Comparator<FleetMemberAPI> c = new Comparator<FleetMemberAPI>() {
608                        public int compare(FleetMemberAPI o1, FleetMemberAPI o2) {
609                                return o2.getHullSpec().getHullSize().ordinal() - o1.getHullSpec().getHullSize().ordinal();
610                        }
611                };
612                Collections.sort(combat, c);
613                Collections.sort(freighter, c);
614                Collections.sort(tanker, c);
615                Collections.sort(liner, c);
616                Collections.sort(other, c);
617                
618                int [] ratio = new int [] { 4, 2, 1, 1 };
619                //int [] ratio = new int [] { 1, 2, 2, 1 };
620                
621                //doctrineSize = 2;
622//              if (doctrineSize == 4) {
623//                      ratio = new int [] { 3, 3, 1, 1 };
624//              } else if (doctrineSize == 3) {
625//                      ratio = new int [] { 2, 3, 2, 1 };
626//              } else if (doctrineSize <= 2) {
627//                      ratio = new int [] { 2, 3, 2, 1 };
628//              }
629                //ratio[3] = 0;
630                //ratio = new int [] { 4, 0, 0, 0 };
631                
632                addAll(ratio, combat, keep, keepCombat, random);
633                //addAll(ratio, civ, keep, keepCiv, random);
634                
635                addAll(ratio, freighter, keep, (int)f, random);
636                addAll(ratio, tanker, keep, (int)t, random);
637                addAll(ratio, liner, keep, (int)l, random);
638                addAll(ratio, other, keep, (int)o, random); // adds a Hermes since that's "other" but we don't really care
639                
640                for (FleetMemberAPI member : copy) {
641                        if (!keep.contains(member)) {
642                                fleet.getFleetData().removeFleetMember(member);
643                        }
644                }
645
646                float currFP = getFP(fleet);
647                if (currFP > targetFP) {
648                        fleet.getFleetData().sort();
649                        copy = fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();
650                        //Collections.reverse(copy);
651                        //Collections.shuffle(copy, random);
652                        for (int i = 0; i < copy.size()/2; i+=2) {
653                                FleetMemberAPI f1 = copy.get(i);
654                                FleetMemberAPI f2 = copy.get(copy.size() - 1 - i);
655                                copy.set(i, f2);
656                                copy.set(copy.size() - 1 - i, f1);
657                        }
658//                      
659//                      float fpGoal = currFP - targetFP;
660//                      float fpDone = 0;
661//                      for (FleetMemberAPI curr : copy) {
662//                              if (curr.isCivilian()) continue;
663//                              for (FleetMemberAPI replace : combat) {
664//                                      float fpCurr = curr.getFleetPointCost();
665//                                      float fpReplace = replace.getFleetPointCost();
666//                                      if (fpCurr > fpReplace) {
667//                                              fpDone += fpCurr - fpReplace;
668//                                              combat.remove(replace);
669//                                              fleet.getFleetData().removeFleetMember(curr);
670//                                              fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(replace);
671//                                              break;
672//                                      }
673//                              }
674//                              if (fpDone >= fpGoal) {
675//                                      break;
676//                              }
677//                      }
678                        
679                        float fpGoal = currFP - targetFP;
680                        float fpDone = 0;
681                        for (FleetMemberAPI curr : copy) {
682                                if (curr.isCivilian()) continue;
683                                FleetMemberAPI best = null;
684                                float bestDiff = 0f;
685                                for (FleetMemberAPI replace : combat) {
686                                        float fpCurr = curr.getFleetPointCost();
687                                        float fpReplace = replace.getFleetPointCost();
688                                        if (fpCurr > fpReplace) {
689                                                float fpDiff = fpCurr - fpReplace;
690                                                if (fpDone + fpDiff <= fpGoal) {
691                                                        best = replace;
692                                                        bestDiff = fpDiff;
693                                                        break;
694                                                } else {
695                                                        if (fpDiff < bestDiff) {
696                                                                best = replace;
697                                                                bestDiff = fpDiff;
698                                                        }
699                                                }
700                                        }
701                                }
702                                if (best != null) {
703                                        fpDone += bestDiff;
704                                        combat.remove(best);
705                                        fleet.getFleetData().removeFleetMember(curr);
706                                        fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(best);
707                                }
708                                if (fpDone >= fpGoal) {
709                                        break;
710                                }
711                        }
712                        
713                }
714                
715        }

717        public static void addAll(int [] ratio, List<FleetMemberAPI> from, LinkedHashSet<FleetMemberAPI> to, int num, Random random) {
718                int added = 0;
719                if (num <= 5) {
720                        while (added < num && !from.isEmpty()) {
721                                to.add(from.remove(0));
722                                added++;
723                        }
724                        return;
725                }
726                
727                WeightedRandomPicker<HullSize> picker = makePicker(ratio, random);
728                for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
729                        if (picker.isEmpty()) picker = makePicker(ratio, random);
730                        OUTER: while (!picker.isEmpty()) {
731                                HullSize size = picker.pickAndRemove();
732                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : from) {
733                                        if (member.getHullSpec().getHullSize() == size) {
734                                                to.add(member);
735                                                from.remove(member);
736                                                added++;
737                                                break OUTER;
738                                        }
739                                }
740                        }
741                        
742                }
743                
744                // if we failed to add up to num, add the largest ships until we've got num
745                // assumes from list is sorted descending by size
746                while (added < num && !from.isEmpty()) {
747                        to.add(from.remove(0));
748                        added++;
749                }
750                
751        }

753        public static WeightedRandomPicker<HullSize> makePicker(int [] ratio, Random random) {
754                WeightedRandomPicker<HullSize> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<HullSize>(random);
755                for (int i = 0; i < ratio[0]; i++) {
756                        picker.add(HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP);
757                }
758                for (int i = 0; i < ratio[1]; i++) {
759                        picker.add(HullSize.CRUISER);
760                }
761                for (int i = 0; i < ratio[2]; i++) {
762                        picker.add(HullSize.DESTROYER);
763                }
764                for (int i = 0; i < ratio[3]; i++) {
765                        picker.add(HullSize.FRIGATE);
766                }
767//              picker.add(HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP, ratio[0]);
768//              picker.add(HullSize.CRUISER, ratio[1]);
769//              picker.add(HullSize.DESTROYER, ratio[2]);
770//              picker.add(HullSize.FRIGATE, ratio[3]);
771                return picker;  
772        }

1110        public static SkillPickPreference getSkillPrefForShip(FleetMemberAPI member) {
1111                float energy = 0f;
1112                float ballistic = 0f;
1113                float missile = 0f;
1114                float total = 0f;
1115                
1116                for (WeaponSlotAPI slot : member.getHullSpec().getAllWeaponSlotsCopy()) {
1117                        float w = 1f;
1118                        switch (slot.getSlotSize()) {
1119                        case LARGE: w = 4f; break;
1120                        case MEDIUM: w = 2f; break;
1121                        case SMALL: w = 1f; break;
1122                        }
1123                        WeaponType type = slot.getWeaponType();
1124                        if (type == WeaponType.BALLISTIC || type == WeaponType.HYBRID) { 
1125                                ballistic += w;
1126                                total += w;
1127                        } else if (type == WeaponType.ENERGY) { 
1128                                energy += w;
1129                                total += w;
1130                        } else if (type == WeaponType.MISSILE || type == WeaponType.SYNERGY || type == WeaponType.COMPOSITE) { 
1131                                missile += w;
1132                                total += w;
1133                        }
1134                }
1135                
1136                if (total <= 0f) total = 1f;
1137                
1138                boolean e = energy >= total * 0.33f;
1139                boolean b = ballistic >= total * 0.33f;
1140                if (b && e) {
1141                        if (ballistic * 1.5f >= energy) {
1142                                e = false;
1143                        } else {
1144                                b = false;
1145                        }
1146                }
1147                boolean m = missile >= total * 0.17f;
1148                
1149                boolean d = member.getHullSpec().getShieldType() == ShieldType.FRONT ||
1150                                        member.getHullSpec().getShieldType() == ShieldType.OMNI || 
1151                                        member.getHullSpec().isPhase();
1152                
1153                // doing things in this, ah, "elegant" way to keep method signatures the same for now...
1154                String n1 = e ? "YES_ENERGY" : "NO_ENERGY";
1155                String n2 = b ? "YES_BALLISTIC" : "NO_BALLISTIC";
1156                String n3 = m ? "YES_MISSILE" : "NO_MISSILE";
1157                String n4 = d ? "YES_DEFENSE" : "NO_DEFENSE";
1158                SkillPickPreference pref = SkillPickPreference.valueOf(n1 + "_" + n2 + "_" + n3 + "_" + n4);
1159                
1160                return pref;
1161        }

1164        public static void addCommanderSkills(PersonAPI commander, CampaignFleetAPI fleet, FleetParamsV3 params, Random random) {
1165                if (params != null && params.noCommanderSkills != null && params.noCommanderSkills) return;
1166                
1167                if (random == null) random = new Random();
1168                
1169                MutableCharacterStatsAPI stats = commander.getStats();
1170                int level = stats.getLevel();
1171                
1172                int forOne = Global.getSettings().getInt("commanderLevelForOneSkill");
1173                int forTwo = Global.getSettings().getInt("commanderLevelForTwoSkills");
1174                
1175                int numSkills = 0;
1176                if (level >= forTwo) {
1177                        numSkills = 2;
1178                } else if (level >= forOne) {
1179                        numSkills = 1;
1180                }
1181
1182                if (numSkills <= 0) return;
1183                
1184                FactionDoctrineAPI doctrine = fleet.getFaction().getDoctrine();
1185                if (params != null && params.doctrineOverride != null) {
1186                        doctrine = params.doctrineOverride;
1187                }
1188                
1189                List<String> skills = new ArrayList<String>(doctrine.getCommanderSkills());
1190                
1191                Iterator<String> iter = skills.iterator();
1192                while (iter.hasNext()) {
1193                        String id = iter.next();
1194                        SkillSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(id);
1195                        if (spec != null && spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_PLAYER_ONLY)) {
1196                                iter.remove();
1197                        }
1198                }
1199                
1200                
1201                if (skills.isEmpty()) return;
1202                
1203                if (random.nextFloat() < doctrine.getCommanderSkillsShuffleProbability()) {
1204                        Collections.shuffle(skills, random);
1205                }
1206
1207                stats.setSkipRefresh(true);
1208                
1209                boolean debug = true;
1210                debug = false;
1211                if (debug) System.out.println("Generating commander skills, person level " + stats.getLevel() + ", skills: " + numSkills);
1212                int picks = 0;
1213                for (String skillId : skills) {
1214                        if (debug) System.out.println("Selected skill: [" + skillId + "]");
1215                        stats.setSkillLevel(skillId, 1);
1216                        picks++;
1217                        if (picks >= numSkills) {
1218                                break;
1219                        }
1220                }
1221                if (debug) System.out.println("Done generating commander skills\n");
1222                
1223                stats.setSkipRefresh(false);
1224                stats.refreshCharacterStatsEffects();
1225        }

1228        public static float getMemberWeight(FleetMemberAPI member) {
1229                boolean nonCombat = member.getVariant().isCivilian();
1230                float weight = 0;
1231                switch (member.getVariant().getHullSize()) {
1232                case CAPITAL_SHIP: weight += 8; break;
1233                case CRUISER: weight += 4; break;
1234                case DESTROYER: weight += 2; break;
1235                case FRIGATE: weight += 1; break;
1236                case FIGHTER: weight += 1; break;
1237                }
1238                if (nonCombat) weight *= 0.1f;
1239                return weight;
1240        }

1245        public static MarketAPI pickMarket(FleetParamsV3 params) {
1246                if (params.source != null) return params.source;
1247                if (params.locInHyper == null) return null;
1248                
1249                List<MarketAPI> allMarkets = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy();
1250                
1251                int size = getMinPreferredMarketSize(params);
1252                float distToClosest = Float.MAX_VALUE;
1253                MarketAPI closest = null;
1254                float distToClosestMatchingSize = Float.MAX_VALUE;
1255                MarketAPI closestMatchingSize = null;
1256                
1257                
1258                FactionAPI creationFaction = Global.getSector().getFaction(params.factionId);
1259                boolean independent = Factions.INDEPENDENT.equals(params.factionId) || 
1260                                                          Factions.SCAVENGERS.equals(params.factionId) ||
1261                                                          creationFaction.getCustomBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_SPAWNS_AS_INDEPENDENT);
1262                
1263                for (MarketAPI market : allMarkets) {
1264                        if (market.getPrimaryEntity() == null) continue;
1265                        
1266                        if (independent) {
1267                                boolean hostileToIndependent = market.getFaction().isHostileTo(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
1268                                if (hostileToIndependent) continue;
1269                        } else {
1270                                if (!market.getFactionId().equals(params.factionId)) continue;
1271                        }
1272                        
1273                        float currDist = Misc.getDistance(market.getPrimaryEntity().getLocationInHyperspace(),
1274                                                                                          params.locInHyper);
1275                        if (currDist < distToClosest) {
1276                                distToClosest = currDist;
1277                                closest = market;
1278                        }
1279                        
1280                        if (market.getSize() >= size && currDist < distToClosestMatchingSize) {
1281                                distToClosestMatchingSize = currDist;
1282                                closestMatchingSize = market;
1283                        }
1284                }
1285                
1286                if (closestMatchingSize != null) {
1287                        return closestMatchingSize;
1288                }
1289                
1290                if (closest != null) {
1291                        return closest;
1292                }
1293                
1294//              MarketAPI temp = Global.getFactory().createMarket("temp", "Temp", size);
1295//              temp.setFactionId(params.factionId);
1296//              return temp;
1297                return null;
1298        }

1300        public static int getMinPreferredMarketSize(FleetParamsV3 params) {
1301                float fp = params.getTotalPts();
1302                
1303                if (fp <= 20) return 1;
1304                if (fp <= 50) return 3;
1305                if (fp <= 100) return 5;
1306                if (fp <= 150) return 7;
1307                
1308                return 8;
1309        }

1315        public static CampaignFleetAPI createEmptyFleet(String factionId, String fleetType, MarketAPI market) {
1316                FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(factionId);
1317                String fleetName = faction.getFleetTypeName(fleetType); 
1318                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = Global.getFactory().createEmptyFleet(factionId, fleetName, true);
1319                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_FLEET_TYPE, fleetType);
1320                
1321                if (market != null && !market.getId().equals("fake")) {
1322                        fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SOURCE_MARKET, market.getId());
1323                }
1324                
1325                if (startingAbilities == null) {
1326                        startingAbilities = new ArrayList<String>();
1327                        for (String id : Global.getSettings().getSortedAbilityIds()) {
1328                                AbilitySpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getAbilitySpec(id);
1329                                if (spec.isAIDefault()) {
1330                                        startingAbilities.add(id);
1331                                }
1332                        }
1333                }
1334                
1335                for (String id : startingAbilities) {
1336                        fleet.addAbility(id);
1337                }
1338                
1339                return fleet;
1340        }

1355                                        new ShipPickParams(params.mode, maxFP, params.timestamp, params.blockFallback), random, null);

1359                return total;

1365                member.setShipName(name);
1366                fleet.getFleetData().addFleetMember(member);
1367                return member.getFleetPointCost();
1368        }

1423        public static boolean addShips(String role, int count, MarketAPI market, Random random, CampaignFleetAPI fleet, FPRemaining rem, FleetParamsV3 params) {
1424                boolean addedSomething = false;
1425                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
1426                        if (rem.fp <= 0) break;
1427                        float added = addToFleet(role, market, random, fleet, rem.fp, params);
1428                        if (added > 0) {
1429                                rem.fp -= added;
1430                                addedSomething = true;
1431                        }
1432                }
1433                return addedSomething;
1434        }

1482        public static enum SizeFilterMode {
1483                NONE,
1484                SMALL_IS_FRIGATE,
1485                SMALL_IS_DESTROYER,
1486        }
1487        public static float addCarrierFleetPoints(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, Random random, float fp, FleetParamsV3 params) {
1488                return addPriorityOnlyThenAll(fleet, random, fp, params, SizeFilterMode.SMALL_IS_DESTROYER,
1489                                                ShipRoles.CARRIER_SMALL, ShipRoles.CARRIER_MEDIUM, ShipRoles.CARRIER_LARGE);

1491        public static float addPriorityOnlyThenAll(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, Random random, float fp, FleetParamsV3 params,
1492                                                                                                SizeFilterMode sizeFilterMode,
1493                                                                                                String roleSmall, String roleMedium, String roleLarge) {
1494                if (fp <= 0) return 0f;
1495                
1496                float added = 0f;
1497                if (params.mode == ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL) {
1498                        int numPriority = fleet.getFaction().getNumAvailableForRole(roleSmall, ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_ONLY) +
1499                                                      fleet.getFaction().getNumAvailableForRole(roleMedium, ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_ONLY) + 
1500                                                      fleet.getFaction().getNumAvailableForRole(roleLarge, ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_ONLY);
1501                
1502                        if (numPriority > 0) {
1503                                params.mode = ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_ONLY;
1504                                added = addFleetPoints(fleet, random, fp, params, sizeFilterMode,
1505                                                roleSmall, roleMedium, roleLarge);
1506                                params.mode = ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL;
1507                        } else {
1508                                params.mode = ShipPickMode.ALL;
1509                                added = addFleetPoints(fleet, random, fp, params, sizeFilterMode,
1510                                                roleSmall, roleMedium, roleLarge);
1511                                params.mode = ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL;
1512                        }
1513                        // if there ARE priority ships for a 3-type category (i.e. carriers/phases/various civs,
1514                        // then ONLY use priority, and use nothing if a priority ship was not added (since that just means not enough FP 
1515                        // for likely a smaller fleet.)
1516//                      if (added <= 0) {
1517//                              added = addFleetPoints(fleet, random, fp, params, sizeFilterMode,
1518//                                              roleSmall, roleMedium, roleLarge);
1519//                      }
1520                } else {                
1521                        added = addFleetPoints(fleet, random, fp, params, sizeFilterMode,
1522                                        roleSmall, roleMedium, roleLarge);
1523                }
1524                return added;
1525        }

1579        public static float addFleetPoints(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, Random random, float fp, FleetParamsV3 params,
1580                                                                           SizeFilterMode sizeFilterMode,
1581                                                                                String ... roles) {
1582                FactionDoctrineAPI doctrine = fleet.getFaction().getDoctrine();
1583                if (params.doctrineOverride != null) {
1584                        doctrine = params.doctrineOverride;
1585                }
1586
1587                int size = doctrine.getShipSize();
1588                //size = getAdjustedDoctrineSize(size, fleet);
1589
1590                boolean addedSomething = true;
1591                FPRemaining rem = new FPRemaining();
1592                rem.fp = (int) fp;
1593
1594                while (addedSomething && rem.fp > 0) {
1595                        size = getAdjustedDoctrineSize(size, fleet);
1596                        
1597                        int small = BASE_COUNTS_WITH_3[size - 1][0] + random.nextInt(MAX_EXTRA_WITH_3[size - 1][0] + 1); 
1598                        int medium = BASE_COUNTS_WITH_3[size - 1][1] + random.nextInt(MAX_EXTRA_WITH_3[size - 1][1] + 1); 
1599                        int large = BASE_COUNTS_WITH_3[size - 1][2] + random.nextInt(MAX_EXTRA_WITH_3[size - 1][2] + 1); 
1600
1601//                      if (sizeOverride > 0) {
1602//                              small = 0;
1603//                              medium = 0;
1604//                      }
1605                        
1606                        if (sizeFilterMode == SizeFilterMode.SMALL_IS_FRIGATE) {
1607                                if (params.maxShipSize <= 1) medium = 0;
1608                                if (params.maxShipSize <= 2) large = 0;
1609                        } else if (sizeFilterMode == SizeFilterMode.SMALL_IS_DESTROYER) {
1610                                if (params.maxShipSize <= 2) medium = 0;
1611                                if (params.maxShipSize <= 3) large = 0;
1612                        }
1613                        
1614                        //System.out.println(String.format("Small: %s Medium: %s Large: %s Capital: %s",
1615                        //"" + small, "" + medium, "" + large, "" + capital));
1616
1617                        int smallPre = small / 2;
1618                        small -= smallPre;
1619
1620                        int mediumPre = medium / 2;
1621                        medium -= mediumPre;
1622
1623                        addedSomething = false;
1624
1625                        addedSomething |= addShips(roles[0], smallPre, params.source, random, fleet, rem, params);
1626
1627                        addedSomething |= addShips(roles[1], mediumPre, params.source, random, fleet, rem, params);
1628                        addedSomething |= addShips(roles[0], small, params.source, random, fleet, rem, params);
1629
1630                        addedSomething |= addShips(roles[2], large, params.source, random, fleet, rem, params);
1631                        addedSomething |= addShips(roles[1], medium, params.source, random, fleet, rem, params);
1632                }
1633
1634                return fp - rem.fp;
1635        }

1641        public static void addCombatFleetPoints(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, Random random,
1642                        float warshipFP, float carrierFP, float phaseFP, FleetParamsV3 params) {
1643                
1644                FactionAPI faction = fleet.getFaction();
1645                FactionDoctrineAPI doctrine = faction.getDoctrine();
1646                if (params.doctrineOverride != null) {
1647                        doctrine = params.doctrineOverride;
1648                }
1649
1650                WeightedRandomPicker<String> smallPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
1651                WeightedRandomPicker<String> mediumPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);

1853        protected static void addToPriorityOnlySet(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, Set<String> set, String small, String medium, String large) {
1854                int numPriority = fleet.getFaction().getNumAvailableForRole(small, ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_ONLY) +
1855                                          fleet.getFaction().getNumAvailableForRole(medium, ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_ONLY) + 
1856                                          fleet.getFaction().getNumAvailableForRole(large, ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_ONLY);
1857                if (numPriority > 0) {
1858                        set.add(small);
1859                        set.add(medium);
1860                        set.add(large);
1861                }
1862        }

1864        protected static void redistributeFP(FPRemaining one, FPRemaining two, FPRemaining three, int newTotal) {
1865                float total = one.fp + two.fp + three.fp;
1866                if (total <= 0) return;
1867                
1868                int f1 = (int) Math.round((float)one.fp / total * newTotal);
1869                int f2 = (int) Math.round((float)two.fp / total * newTotal);
1870                int f3 = (int) Math.round((float)three.fp / total * newTotal);
1871                
1872                f1 += newTotal - f1 - f2 - f3;
1873                
1874                one.fp = f1;
1875                two.fp = f2;
1876                three.fp = f3;
1877        }

1879        public static boolean addShips(WeightedRandomPicker<String> rolePicker, Set<String> usePriorityOnly, Map<String, FPRemaining> remaining, FPRemaining remOverride, int count,
1880                                                                   CampaignFleetAPI fleet, Random random, FleetParamsV3 params) {
1881                if (rolePicker.isEmpty()) return false;
1882                
1883                boolean addedSomething = false;
1884                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
1885                        String role = rolePicker.pick();
1886                        if (role == null) break;
1887                        FPRemaining rem = remaining.get(role);
1888                        FPRemaining remForProperRole = rem;
1889                        if (remOverride != null) rem = remOverride;
1890                        if (usePriorityOnly.contains(role)) {
1891                                params.mode = ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_ONLY;
1892                        }
1893                        int fpPrePick = rem.fp;
1894                        
1895                        boolean added = addShips(role, 1, params.source, random, fleet, rem, params);
1896                        
1897                        if (added && remOverride != null) {
1898                                int fpSpent = fpPrePick - rem.fp;
1899                                int maxToTakeFromProperRole = Math.min(remForProperRole.fp, fpSpent);
1900                                remForProperRole.fp -= maxToTakeFromProperRole;
1901                        }
1902                        
1903                        if (usePriorityOnly.contains(role)) {
1904                                params.mode = ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL;
1905                        }
1906                        if (!added) {
1907                                rolePicker.remove(role);
1908                                i--;
1909                                if (rolePicker.isEmpty()) {
1910                                        break;
1911                                }
1912                        }
1913                        addedSomething |= added;
1914                }
1915                return addedSomething;
1916        }

1918        public static float getShipDeficitFleetSizeMult(MarketAPI market) {
1919                float mult = 1f;
1920                CommodityOnMarketAPI com = market.getCommodityData(Commodities.SHIPS);
1921                float available = com.getAvailable();
1922                float demand = com.getMaxDemand();
1923                if (demand > 0) {
1924                        float f = available / demand;
1925                        if (f < MIN_NUM_SHIPS_DEFICIT_MULT) f = MIN_NUM_SHIPS_DEFICIT_MULT;
1926                        mult *= f;
1927                }
1928                if (mult < 0) mult = 0;
1929                if (mult > 1) mult = 1;
1930                return mult;
1931        }

1940        public static void applyDamageToFleet(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, float damage, 
1941                                                                                  boolean damageRemainingShips, Random random) {
1942                if (random == null) random = Misc.random;
1943                WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI>();
1944                
1945                List<FleetMemberAPI> members = fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();
1946                for (FleetMemberAPI member : members) {
1947                        float w = 1f;
1948                        if (member.isCivilian()) w *= 0.25f;
1949                        
1950                        picker.add(member, w);
1951                }
1952                
1953                List<FleetMemberAPI> remove = new ArrayList<FleetMemberAPI>();
1954                float removedFP = 0f;
1955                float fpToRemove = fleet.getFleetPoints() * damage * 0.8f;
1956                
1957                while (removedFP < fpToRemove && remove.size() < members.size() - 1 && !picker.isEmpty()) {
1958                        FleetMemberAPI member = picker.pickAndRemove();
1959                        removedFP += member.getFleetPointCost();
1960                        remove.add(member);
1961                }
1962                
1963                for (FleetMemberAPI member : remove) {
1964                        fleet.getFleetData().removeFleetMember(member);
1965                }
1966                
1967                
1968                if (damageRemainingShips) {
1969                        int numStrikes = (int) Math.round(picker.getItems().size() * damage);
1970                        
1971                        for (int i = 0; i < numStrikes; i++) {
1972                                FleetMemberAPI member = picker.pick();
1973                                if (member == null) return;
1974                                
1975                                if (random.nextFloat() > damage) continue;
1976                                
1977                                float crPerDep = member.getDeployCost();
1978                                //if (crPerDep <= 0) continue;                  
1979                                float suppliesPerDep = member.getStats().getSuppliesToRecover().getModifiedValue();
1980                                if (suppliesPerDep <= 0 || crPerDep <= 0) return;
1981                                float suppliesPer100CR = suppliesPerDep * 1f / Math.max(0.01f, crPerDep);
1982        
1983                                float strikeSupplies = suppliesPer100CR * damage * (0.25f + 0.75f * random.nextFloat());  
1984                                float strikeDamage = strikeSupplies / suppliesPer100CR * (0.75f + (float) Math.random() * 0.5f);
1985                                
1986                                if (strikeDamage > HyperspaceTerrainPlugin.STORM_MAX_STRIKE_DAMAGE) {
1987                                        strikeDamage = HyperspaceTerrainPlugin.STORM_MAX_STRIKE_DAMAGE;
1988                                }
1989                                
1990                                if (strikeDamage > 0) {
1991                                        float currCR = member.getRepairTracker().getBaseCR();
1992                                        float crDamage = Math.min(currCR, strikeDamage);
1993                                        
1994                                        member.getRepairTracker().setCR(currCR - crDamage);
1995                                        
1996                                        float hitStrength = member.getStats().getArmorBonus().computeEffective(member.getHullSpec().getArmorRating());
1997                                        int numHits = (int) (strikeDamage / 0.1f);
1998                                        if (numHits < 1) numHits = 1;
1999                                        for (int j = 0; j < numHits; j++) {
2000                                                member.getStatus().applyDamage(hitStrength);
2001                                        }
2002                                        
2003                                        if (member.getStatus().getHullFraction() < 0.01f) {
2004                                                member.getStatus().setHullFraction(0.01f);
2005                                                picker.remove(member);
2006                                        } else {
2007                                                float w = picker.getWeight(member);
2008                                                picker.setWeight(picker.getItems().indexOf(member), w * 0.5f);
2009                                        }
2010                                }
2011                        }
2012                }
2013        }
